item.title: New Orleans is testing Carbyne’s AI-powered Emergency Call Triage software
item.description:
📝 Why is New Orleans using AI to answer 911 dispatch calls. The OPCD is using Carbyne's AI Emergency Call Triage, with triage being the process of analyzing and prioritizing emergency calls. AI-powered 911 triage is programmed to divert non-urgent calls during surges in the number of calls.
🔗 Read more: https://www.shreveporttimes.com/story/news/local/louisiana/2026/07/28/is-new-orleans-using-ai-to-answer-911-calls-instead-of-human-dispatchers-impacts-emergencies-crime/91065014007/
